asset_inventory_lines_kind_check.name: asset_inventory_lines_kind_check
asset_inventory_lines_kind_check.value: ("asset_inventory_lines"."asset_id" is not null) <> ("asset_inventory_lines"."extra_name" is not null)

loan_lines_asset_out_key.name: loan_lines_asset_out_key
loan_lines_asset_out_key.where: "loan_lines"."out_at" is not null and "loan_lines"."returned_at" is null

proposal_lines_check.name: proposal_lines_check
proposal_lines_check.value: "proposal_lines"."qty" > 0 and "proposal_lines"."est_price" >= 0 and ("proposal_lines"."qty_approved" is null or "proposal_lines"."qty_approved" >= 0) and "proposal_lines"."priority" between 1 and 3

supply_request_lines_qty_check.name: supply_request_lines_qty_check
supply_request_lines_qty_check.value: "supply_request_lines"."qty_requested" > 0 and ("supply_request_lines"."qty_approved" is null or "supply_request_lines"."qty_approved" >= 0) and ("supply_request_lines"."qty_issued" is null or "supply_request_lines"."qty_issued" >= 0)
